name: Knight's Hourglass Harness
kind: armour set for the villagers (skinned to their CharacterArmature)
description: Full plate in the manner of the great crusader harnesses: a fluted breastplate with a dark inlaid panel under Lord Velscour's gold V, big lamed pauldrons with upright neck guards and V rondels, brass-edged faulds and tassets, V-bossed knee cops, a crimson cape bearing his V, and a riveted great helm with a cross of bands, eye slits and round breaths.

meshes.Armor: body, arms, legs and the set's gauntlets

hide_when_worn: the villager's body meshes (every mesh not named V_*)
